user.title: Local radio ad detector
user.description: Enter Home Assistant's LAN IP address reachable by your Chromecast. Audio analysis runs inside this integration. The first setup downloads a verified audio model (~16 MB).

error.invalid_host: Enter a LAN IPv4 or IPv6 address reachable by your speaker.
error.port_in_use: That port is already in use. Choose another port.
error.unsupported_platform: This release is missing the native runtime for your platform. Install a complete release ZIP for Linux ARM64 or x86-64 Home Assistant OS/Container.
error.ffmpeg_missing: FFmpeg is required. It is included in Home Assistant OS and Container.

abort.already_configured: Radio Ad Detector is already configured.

data_description.output_format: WAV starts faster on Cast speakers and uses about 1.4 Mb/s on the local network. Original MP3 saves local network traffic but can take longer to start.
